svg.text: Patterns are labeled where they live. Orange markers pin a problem to the exact place it is solved — legend right. Ink lines: request path. Slate lines: data / background flow. Dashed borders: trust boundaries.
AGENT SURFACES (clients — anything that speaks MCP)
CUSTOMER INFRASTRUCTURE (your AWS account · eu-central-1 · everything here deploys via kit deploy)

g.text: MCP over streamable HTTP. Prep interviews,
entry review, any kit. No kit-specific client code.
Twilio media ⇄ STT ⇄ LLM ⇄ TTS loop. Calls the
same kit tools as chat — same session object.
EventBridge one-off schedules. Invokes kit tools
with the same validated contract as any client.
calling another kit is still a routed MCP call.
kit repo: tools/ + skills/ side by side,
register at router → keys in dashboard.
Anthropic API et al. Reached only
no direct provider keys inside kits.

svg.text: single MCP entrypoint · stateless · N replicas behind LB · hop cost: microseconds vs LLM seconds

g.text: call with missing params → returns resolution instructions, not an error. Discovery = state machine, not catalog search.
typed returns chain by ID; one action → one output. No intermediate calls to re-bill next turn.
served in-band by the router's skill resolver; version logged per session; override-able without redeploy.
SDK keeps state client-side; clicks cost zero tokens; only committed actions reach the model.
runtime-learned facts; writes land here; reads may climb the hierarchy via router ACL.
trigger plugin — transport only (webhooks in, events out, zero logic)

svg.text: same onion, your workflow. Business logic
only — router + SDK carry everything else.
one CLI command from repo to registered,

g.text: staged overrides; promote if evals pass AND
live ≥ baseline; promoted → PR back to repo

svg.text: MCP · streamable HTTP · authN per agent · every call metered
tool call in → result + next-move guidance out (in-band skills)

g.text: Output ≈5× input; chained CRUD re-bills grown context
every turn. → workflow tools: one action, one output.
No attribution per team / agent / call. → meter at the one
place every call must pass: the router.
Lazy-loaded catalogs vary run to run; p95 blows up on
wrong turns. → progressive disclosure: the response
names the next legal move. Deterministic path.
Full-HTML re-render per click. → shell + lazy data, state
TLS, auth, secrets, logging, limits, pipeline, registration —
rebuilt and re-audited per MCP server. → solved once;
a kit is business logic + one command.
Guidance drifts from APIs; definitions drift across teams.
→ skills versioned beside tools, overrides pinned to
IAM, audit, DSGVO, AI Act, Betriebsrat as afterthoughts.
→ identity per agent + tool at the hub; memory inherits
ACL; audit chain is one query; no per-person metrics.
Request path (ink): surface → router → kit → response with
guidance. Background (slate): deploy, skills, memory, scores.
Nothing crosses a boundary except through the router —
that single fact is what makes 2, 6 and 7 solvable at all.
